title: ERC-8004 actors and trust boundaries
caption: Five trust zones. The owner controls the token, the file and the wallet binding; clients write feedback; the chain holds three registries, one of them specified but not officially deployed; off-chain hosts serve files the chain never reads; indexers turn events into rankings. Payment happens elsewhere.
alt: Flowchart. The owner zone holds the agent owner, operators and the agent wallet. The owner registers and updates the agent in the Identity Registry and binds the wallet with a signature. The off-chain zone holds the registration file host, the .well-known domain proof and feedback files. The client zone holds clients and responders, which call giveFeedback and appendResponse on the Reputation Registry. The owner's validationRequest edge to the Validation Registry is dashed, because that registry is specified, not officially deployed. The registry owner can upgrade the registries: one externally owned account on Ethereum and Base; on BSC a Safe multisig owns the Identity and Reputation proxies and an EIP-7702 account owns the Validation proxy. Indexers and explorers read events and files. A payment rail such as x402 sits outside ERC-8004.
